args.title: Fix password reset email linking to localhost in production
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is unset, and this fallback is used to build the password reset link (and other links in this file). In production, PUBLIC_URL is apparently not set, so reset emails point users to localhost instead of the real app URL.

Proposed fix: ensure PUBLIC_URL is set in the production environment/config, and/or change BASE_URL to read from a required config value (e.g. config.publicUrl) instead of silently falling back to localhost, so a missing production URL fails loudly rather than producing broken links in emails.
